about: A small, hand-made synthetic ward for prototyping the patient list and later features. Every person, identifier, time and value is invented and is not clinical advice. Shape follows decision 0019; a Synthea-based generator replaces it later. Comments, allied health, discharge barriers and the list's other app data are kept apart in `sources.app`; `directory` holds registered patients on no list.

notes.latestNote: A DocumentReference: its type, author and date. The summary is the note's opening line as written, read from its Binary content. Nothing generates it.
notes.alliedHealth: A referral to physiotherapy (PT), social work (SW) or occupational therapy (OT) could be a ServiceRequest, which Oracle serves. Whether the patient has been seen, or cleared for discharge, is held by the list.
notes.dischargeBarriers: Short labels the team writes. They match the unit's flags where one fits.
notes.comments: The team's comments on a patient. A transfer's handover is its first comment.
notes.directory: Patients registered at the hospital and on no list, as a Patient search returns them: by identifier, or by family and given name with birthdate and gender.
